verdict.rationale: Missive connects to standard IMAP and SMTP accounts, so mail stays on the user's own provider and other clients can still reach it, which reduces client lock-in. The evidence only shows Missive consuming these protocols as a client. It does not show Missive offering protocol access to its own data or any standards-based export. missing for 10: JMAP support, Missive-provided IMAP/SMTP access to its stored data (e.g. comments, shared-inbox state), standards-based export (mbox/EML) of conversations, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in

citations.quote: Connect Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, or IMAP email accounts to Missive.
